title: Outlook: sort a folder's subfolders from A to Z in new Outlook for Windows and Outlook on the web
summary: The briefing passes: its planned behaviour, rollout target and scope agree with the roadmap, and its licensing statements match Microsoft Learn. Searches found no documented administrative control for this sorting option; the briefing appropriately leaves custom-order replacement, shared-mailbox support and cross-client persistence open.

claims.claim: No feature-specific administrative UI setting or automation control for allowing subfolder sorting is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Outlook subfolder sort order admin policy Set-OwaMailboxPolicy Set-MailboxMessageConfiguration; Outlook folder sort policy. Opened Policy Management, Map classic Outlook policies, both cmdlet references and Graph mailFolder; found no control for this option.

claims.claim: The Set-OwaMailboxPolicy reference contains no parameter for folder sort order.
claims.quote: Searched: Outlook subfolder sort order admin policy Set-OwaMailboxPolicy Set-MailboxMessageConfiguration. Opened Set-OwaMailboxPolicy, read its full syntax and searched its full reference for sort, folder and alphabet. No folder-sort-order parameter appears.

claims.claim: The Set-MailboxMessageConfiguration reference contains no parameter for folder sort order.
claims.quote: Searched: Outlook subfolder sort order admin policy Set-OwaMailboxPolicy Set-MailboxMessageConfiguration. Read Set-MailboxMessageConfiguration syntax and searched its reference for sort, folder and alphabet. ConversationSortOrder sorts messages, not the folder tree.

claims.claim: Most Outlook-on-the-web mailbox policies apply to both Outlook on the web and new Outlook for Windows.
